controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: USGS mosaic on a 1 km grid; original image resolution varies from 400 m to 60 km per pixel. USGS normalized broad illumination and matched overlapping images. Photographed relief, coarse patches and some seams remain. Gray grid marks documented no-data and its resampled boundary. Added globe lighting is approximate.
controls.summary: Source detail ranges from 400 m to 60 km per pixel. Photographed shadows and seams remain; the gray grid marks missing data.
controls.title: Global image mosaic

controls.label: Galileo color
controls.description: Published NASA/JPL/DLR processed color from Galileo in May 2001, registered to the controlled USGS map. About 8 km per source pixel near the disk center; detail becomes coarser toward the edge. This is display color, not calibrated I/F or albedo. Only views within 65° of the surface normal are retained; gray grid marks the rest of the globe. Photographed shading and color fringes remain; added globe lighting is approximate.
controls.summary: May 2001 Galileo color over about 29% of the globe. Gray grid: unseen or withheld. Processed display colors, not albedo.

facts.label: Source detail
facts.value: About 8 km per pixel near the disk center

controls.title: Processed color mosaic

items.label: Color
items.description: Variable published RGB across observed terrain; this swatch is only a visual key.

items.label: Gray grid
items.description: Unseen or withheld surface; no reconstructed colors.

controls.legendNote: Photographic colors have no numeric scale; they are the publisher’s processed display colors.

controls.label: Infrared
controls.description: Galileo NIMS observations assign red, green and blue to 0.77, 2.25 and 3.66 µm, following the archive guide. This false-color view shows spectral differences, not natural color or mineral abundance. The observations have Minnaert photometric correction; resolution, residual brightness and seams vary. Fixed channel stretches clip extreme values. Gray grid marks areas lacking a valid sample in any selected band.
controls.title: Galileo NIMS spectral color
